Use `AGENTS.md` as the canonical repository guidance for code review.
Apply its package, architecture, Sentry, end-to-end, and PR workflow rules when reviewing changes in this repository.
Evaluate findings against the PR's explicit user intent, related canonical issues, and accepted clarifications. Do not recommend reversing those requirements; identify a genuine requirement conflict explicitly when mandatory repository or safety constraints disagree.
